scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted mandatory closing branding at the end of the call, terminating abruptly with 'Goodbye' and omitting 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached dead air standards twice with unannounced silent gaps of 35s and 38s while querying Openreach portals, prompting the customer to chase whether the line had dropped on both occasions.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent handled the opening outburst with empathy, but when Ella had a second high-distress outburst at turn 47 in the final third regarding taking further unpaid leave, Edward responded with a cold threat of early termination fees.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to confirm resolution or customer understanding, cutting off the customer's question regarding master socket references at turn 61 with an abrupt sign-off.

grader.scenario: Delayed engineer install appointment missed twice by third-party infrastructure contractor
grader.notes: Missed engineer installation escalation call handled by Edward. Customer suffered two missed appointment slots by Openreach. Agent handled opening distress well and owned compensation and backup hardware, but breached Dead Air with two unmanaged pauses, failed Empathy in the last third by threatening cancellation penalties during an outburst, omitted closing branding, and abruptly cut off the caller.
